page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn7i.32xlarge is a high-density GPU-accelerated server built on the x86_64 architecture using KVM virtualization. The configuration equips 128 dedicated vCPUs and 768 GB of system memory, establishing a provision of 6.0 GB RAM per virtual core. Compute and parallel processing tasks are driven by four integrated NVIDIA A10 GPUs delivering a combined 96 GB of VRAM.

Network infrastructure for this instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps to ensure data throughput during cluster orchestration. The server includes no local disk storage, relying entirely on network-attached block storage solutions for persistent data needs. The combination of quad GPUs, high core counts, and high network throughput provides efficient resource utilization for AI inference pipelines, video streaming transcoding, spatial rendering, and cloud gaming.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn7i.32xlarge is a GPU-accelerated bare-metal instance designed for graphics-intensive and artificial intelligence workloads. It features 128 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs and 768 GB of system memory, yielding 6.0 GB of RAM per core. Machine learning and graphics rendering are driven by four integrated NVIDIA A10 GPUs providing 96 GB of aggregate VRAM. Networking capabilities include a 64 Gbps baseline bandwidth to support high-throughput cluster communications. The instance does not include integrated local disk storage, necessitating external network-attached storage. The hardware density of this configuration offers strong qualitative cost efficiency for deployment scenarios such as multi-tenant AI model inference, parallel video transcoding, real-time 3D rendering, and virtual workstation environments.
